import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the gsl_function struct
class GSLFunction(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('function', ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double)),
                ('params', ctypes.c_void_p)]

# Define the gsl_integration_workspace struct
class GSLIntegrationWorkspace(ctypes.Structure):
    pass

# Allocate workspace dynamically
gsl.gsl_integration_workspace_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl.gsl_integration_workspace_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(GSLIntegrationWorkspace)

gsl.gsl_integration_workspace_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLIntegrationWorkspace)]

# Define the function prototype
gsl.gsl_integration_qagp.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLFunction),
                                     ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double),
                                     ctypes.c_size_t,
                                     ctypes.c_double,
                                     ctypes.c_double,
                                     ctypes.c_size_t,
                                     ctypes.POINTER(GSLIntegrationWorkspace),
                                     ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double),
                                     ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)]

gsl.gsl_integration_qagp.restype = ctypes.c_int

# Python function to call the C function
def integrate_function(f, pts, epsabs, epsrel, limit):
    # Convert Python function to C function
    c_func = ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double)(f)
    gsl_func = GSLFunction(c_func, None)

    # Convert points to ctypes array
    pts_array = (ctypes.c_double * len(pts))(*pts)

    # Allocate workspace
    workspace = gsl.gsl_integration_workspace_alloc(limit)
    if not workspace:
        raise MemoryError('Failed to allocate GSL integration workspace')

    try:
        # Prepare result and error variables
        result = ctypes.c_double()
        abserr = ctypes.c_double()

        # Call the C function
        status = gsl.gsl_integration_qagp(ctypes.byref(gsl_func),
                                          pts_array,
                                          len(pts),
                                          epsabs,
                                          epsrel,
                                          limit,
                                          workspace,
                                          ctypes.byref(result),
                                          ctypes.byref(abserr))

        if status != 0:
            raise RuntimeError(f'Integration failed with status {status}')

        return result.value, abserr.value

    finally:
        # Free workspace
        gsl.gsl_integration_workspace_free(workspace)

# Test cases
def assert_test():
    # Define a simple function to integrate
    def my_function(x):
        return x * x

    # Test integration
    result, abserr = integrate_function(my_function, [0.0, 1.0], 1e-7, 1e-7, 100)
    assert abs(result - 1/3) < 1e-7, f'Expected 1/3, got {result}'
    assert abserr < 1e-7, f'Expected error < 1e-7, got {abserr}'

    # Test with different intervals
    result, abserr = integrate_function(my_function, [0.0, 2.0], 1e-7, 1e-7, 100)
    assert abs(result - 8/3) < 1e-7, f'Expected 8/3, got {result}'
    assert abserr < 1e-7, f'Expected error < 1e-7, got {abserr}'

if __name__ == '__main__':
    assert_test()
